app.title: Image White Balancing Survey
landing.heading: Welcome
landing.intro: You will see several versions of the same photo, that are balanced differently. For each photo we ask which version you prefer. There are no right or wrong answers. Your responses are saved anonymously.
landing.tips: For the best results, use a computer or tablet screen and turn off any night mode or blue-light filter.
landing.consent: I agree to the use of the answers I submit for research purposes.
question: Which image looks best to you?
question.hint: Pick the one you like the most, optionally adjusting sliders to better match your ideal result.
slider.title: If your pick isn't quite right you can adjust it with the sliders.
done.heading: Thank you!
done.body: Your answers have been saved. You can close this page now.
